title.narrative: The Graduate Entrepreneurship and Employment Readiness (GEER) : IMED
The Graduate Entrepreneurship and Employment Readiness (GEER)

description.narrative: The project will address graduate youth unemployment constrained by inadequate experience, social capital (networks), capital, entrepreneurial, business skills, and the other soft skills that limit their start-up and success. The overall objective of the project is increase youth employment by easing the transition from tertiary institutions to salaried jobs and self-employment through internships incorporating training, mentoring, coaching and linkages of both graduates. The project aims at developing the employability and entrepreneurial capacity of graduates from all colleges and vocational training institutions in Dar Es Salaam and Morogoro regions through training on key entrepreneurship and employability soft skills, mentoring, coaching, internship, and job linkages The two years project will be implemented in Tanzania mainland and will focus on agroforestry, agro-processing, and energy. Direct beneficiaries of this Project are 200 young Youth who will be recruited from tertiary training institutions from all over Tanzania. Hundreds of youth will be reached through online platform of the organization. Entrepreneurship, Management and Development (IMED) Foundation is the main implementer. The organization was selected through call for the proposal and they fitted in the criteria as announced during the call: e.g. legally registered, they have sound financial management and internal control system, they have relevant policies to guide the organization, they have human resources and infrastructures, and they have experiences working on the theme and international donors, statuary compliances. Link to website: https://imedfoundation.or.tz/
